prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Dorbit alien Scout spaceship 3D modeling and texturing reference sheet. Create a polished landscape production concept sheet, light neutral gray background and clear thin dividers. This is an ALIEN SPACECRAFT, no humanoid creature. Original design for arcade full-3D space combat: small agile predatory drone, narrow pointed central hull, two swept angular crescent wings, paired recessed rear thrusters, small twin forward laser emitters, no human cockpit. Strong readable silhouette, bilateral symmetry. Alien armor resembles manufactured layered dark gunmetal carapace with fitted burnt-amber armor plates, graphite mechanical recesses, brushed titanium edges, restrained amber emissive sensor slits. Plausible buildable solid shapes, clean chamfers, a few large details rather than tiny greeble noise. Same craft geometry and panel layout across EVERY view. Layout: a large front three-quarter beauty render occupying upper left; five clean orthographic views arranged neatly in the rest of the sheet, TOP, SIDE, FRONT, REAR, UNDERSIDE, all uncropped with generous spacing and matched scale. Orthographic views have no perspective foreshortening, wings and engine positions must agree. A bottom strip has three macro material closeups: amber coated armor with fine grain and light edge wear, brushed gunmetal trim, recessed amber sensor and dark machinery. Soft neutral studio light, sharp surface detail, subtle shadow, no dramatic glow washing out panels. Exact title 'SCOUT'; small view labels 'PERSPECTIVE', 'TOP', 'SIDE', 'FRONT', 'REAR', 'UNDERSIDE'; bottom title 'MATERIAL REFERENCES'. No lore text, numeric measurements, logos, watermark, stars, planet, flight effects, weapons firing, UI. Render like a realistic game asset concept with PBR materials, compatible with a restrained fitted-armor science fiction ship aesthetic. This sheet is modeling guidance, not a UV texture atlas.
